abstract_sentences.text: Active reasoning requires large language model (LLM) agents to interact with external sources and strategically gather information to solve problems in multiple turns.
Central to this process is belief tracking: maintaining an accurate representation of the underlying state and uncertainty in understanding and solving the problem.

However, due to limited reasoning capabilities, LLM-based agents often suffer belief deviation: their internal beliefs drift from the true problem state, leading to loss of state awareness and uninformative or repetitive actions.

evidence.anchor: beliefs drift from the true problem state

abstract_sentences.text: Once this happens, errors compound in the trajectories used for reinforcement learning (RL), leading to misattributed credits and limited exploration.

To address this issue, we propose to track belief deviation and develop T3, a simple yet principled method that detects excessive deviation and truncates training trajectories to suppress uninformative tail effects.
Hence, T3 preserves credits for informative prefixes and systematically improves policy optimization.
Across 5 challenging tasks, T3 consistently enhances training stability and yields performance gains of up to 30 points while cutting token cost by up to 34%.
These results highlight belief control as a key principle for building robust LLM agents capable of active reasoning.

final_judgment.single_storyline: 在部分可观测 active reasoning 中，更新误差随 belief deviation 增大，轨迹进入 BTR；其 uninformative tail 通过 outcome-RL 的 GAE 污染 prefix credit，T3 用持续 stall proxy 截断尾部。
final_judgment.main_body_keeps: POMDP/Ψ/cθ 最小形式化、BTR/advantage 理论主张、Def.2 proxy principle、五任务实例化、Table 1、training/token 曲线、OOD 表和主要消融。
final_judgment.appendix_moves: formal statements/proofs、surrogate Assumption 1 fit、fixed-policy GAE 与 false-positive controls、threshold/ground-truth-free/adaptive variants、dataset/prompt、RL objective、hardware 与超参。
final_judgment.best_pattern: Fig.1 将 vanilla/T3 rollout 与 credit 对照；Fig.8 把 tail length、truncation strength 和 early-token GAE 放入同一机制图组；Table 3 同时放 window 与 random truncation。
final_judgment.largest_gap: 不可观测真实 belief 与 task-specific proxy 的识别不足、无 seed/uncertainty 报告、ground-truth-assisted PE/MR proxy、general-purpose 外推，以及 Theorem B.1 proof 对逐样本 drift 的潜在额外要求。
final_judgment.transfer_rule: 依赖不可观测内部状态的论文应在正文并列呈现理论状态、可观测 proxy、proxy 误触发代价和最终决策证据。
final_judgment.transfer_boundary: 适用于有 latent-state 理论、trace proxy 和可干预长程 credit 的 agent/RL；没有长期尾部或内部状态可直接测量时不应机械套用。
